limit_kind: 8 GiB private ext4 loop image provides a hard filesystem capacity; sampled guards keep additional reserves; RLIMIT_FSIZE enforces each file limit. Thin image allocation grows only with actual use.
cleanup: Only explicitly owned disposable artifacts; retain inputs, dependency hashes, logs and reports. VM overlays one at a time, retired on completion after receipt validation. No full history extraction or private toolchain duplication.
